en-US: Floe Agent is an iPad-first AI workspace with iPhone support. Continue AI tasks with visible tool activity, read and annotate PDFs in the Notes workspace, organize documents, and develop ideas on a canvas. Cloud AI is bring-your-own-key: connect a provider you choose, and your usage may incur third-party charges. Downloaded MLX local models are a Beta, optional feature and are not recommended as the daily default. Core Notes, documents and Canvas work without an AI provider.
zh-Hans: Floe Agent 是以 iPad 为优先、同时支持 iPhone 的 AI 工作空间。你可以持续处理 AI 任务、查看工具执行记录，在手记工作区阅读 PDF、书写批注，整理文档，并在画布上组织想法与内容。云端 AI 采用自带密钥（BYOK）：连接你选择的服务商，使用可能产生第三方费用。下载的 MLX 本地模型属于 Beta、可选功能，暂不建议作为日常默认。手记、文档和画布的核心功能无需 AI 服务即可使用。
